summary: Grupo Cibest S.A. files Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 quarterly report and disclosing a share buyback program. On March 24, 2026, shareholders approved a new buyback of up to COP 1.35 trillion over three years, replacing the June 2025 program, and transferred COP 431.4 billion from legal reserve to fund it. As of March 31, 2026, the company had repurchased 12,644,634 shares across common, preferred, and ADR classes. This is a capital return to shareholders via open-market repurchases. Watch execution pace and potential EPS accretion; no risk-arb angle as it's not a tender.
